notes: No raw SQL statements were found in the GadgetsOnline codebase. The application uses Entity Framework 6 (EF6) with LINQ queries exclusively for all database operations. All 40 source files were exhaustively scanned (see extracted_statements.sql for complete scan results). The Npgsql EF6 provider generates PostgreSQL-compatible SQL at runtime, eliminating the need for manual SQL statement conversion. Zero statements were processed through the DMS MCP tool (dms-mcp___statement_conversion_tool) and zero statements required equivalency validation through the SQL Equivalency tool (sql-equivalency___validate_sql_equivalence) because no raw SQL exists in the codebase.
